headline: NAYEON returns with 'BABY ANGEL' MV
sub: Her first solo single album 'NA-sty' is out now
source: Source: JYP Entertainment, via Korean media
caption:
TWICE's NAYEON is back! The music video for 'BABY ANGEL' dropped today at 2 PM KST.

'BABY ANGEL' leads her first solo single album 'NA-sty', her first solo release in about 2 years and 5 months since 2nd mini album 'NA'. The 3-track album also includes 'SHiVER' and 'BOY'.

📌 Source: JYP Entertainment, via Korean media
